desc: The graphics watchdog (port/gfx_guard.h, GitHub #39) without a slow GPU: every present seen 300 ms late ($TTYD_GFX_WATCHDOG_FAKE) with the costly options on (paper shadows and edges, bloom, the CRT filter, 2x supersampling, 120 fps): after 20 slow frames step 1 turns them off for the run (the frame rate back to 60, pipelines in the background), after 20 more step 2 draws at 480 lines; the harbour still plays to Mario's control
log_must: ^\[gfx\] watchdog: every interval seen 300 ms longer
^\[gfx\] watchdog: 20 frames on end over 250 ms apart .*: step 1, for this run: supersampling, paper shadows, paper edges, bloom, post filter, in-between frames, waiting for pipelines
^\[gfx\] watchdog: 20 frames on end over 250 ms apart .*: step 2, for this run: the picture at 480 lines
